hook: You don't have to choose between trusting God and living on purpose.
hookSource: The closing line of Faith in Motion (Conclusion).
intro:
Faith in Motion: Steps is a free companion to Herman Davis's book Faith in Motion. It doesn't replace the book. It walks with you through it, one chapter and one real step at a time.

Every stop sends you to a chapter first. Then it helps you name where you're stuck, pick one clear next step, put a date on it, tell one trusted believer, and go do it. No streaks. No scoreboards. Just one honest step a week.

noBook.label: I don't have the book yet
noBook.help: Start here. Read the free sample, try the first stop, and see if it's for you.

haveBook.label: I have the book
haveBook.help: Open the full roadmap. We trust you. No codes, no login.

sample.heading: Read the free sample
sample.body: The Introduction, "The Great Christian Standstill," is free. Read it first. If you've ever called a freeze "faith," you'll recognize yourself.

sampleQuotes.quote: Grace is not a parking space. Grace is a doorway into a new life.
Often courage is the fruit of obedience, not the entrance fee.
Small offered is different from small buried.

tryOne.heading: Try one step free
tryOne.body: Stop 0 works without the book unlocked. Read the free Introduction, then name your standstill in one sentence. That's the first honest step.
tryOne.endNote: The rest of the roadmap walks through each chapter. Get the book to begin.

buy.heading: Get the book
buy.body: Every stop after this one opens with a chapter from the book, so you'll want it open beside you.

kindle.label: Kindle
kindle.note: No Kindle? The free Kindle app works on any phone.

gift.label: Give a copy to a friend

signup.heading: Get the 7 Midday Steps
signup.body: Seven short emails, each with one step from the book. Free. Unsubscribe anytime.
signup.privacy: We'll only use your email to send the Midday Steps and occasional updates about the book.

unlock.heading: I have the book
unlock.body: Great. Tap below and the full roadmap opens. We're on the honor system here, because the app only works with the book open anyway.

install.heading: Keep it on your home screen
install.android: Tap Install when your browser offers it.
install.iphone: In Safari, tap the Share button, then Add to Home Screen.
install.note: Your journal answers are private to you. A testimony or an email signup is sent only if you choose to send it.

home.noStepYet: You haven't set a step yet. Start with the next stop.
home.sundayReview: It's Sunday. How did this week's step go?
home.partnerText: My step this week: [step], by [day]. Will you ask me about it on [day]?
home.sessionEnd: That's enough screen for now. Close the app and go take your step.

about.heading: About
about.body: Faith in Motion: Steps is a free companion to the book Faith in Motion by Herman Davis. Scripture is shown from the ESV. Your journal answers are private to you.
